title: 雙路供電：共同祖先與最小切集
titleEn: Dual power paths: common ancestors and minimal cut sets
subcategoryTitle: 超算機房的熱、電力與控制韌性

summary: 建立 source、UPS、PDU、load 有向圖，每負載列出 A/B 路徑；標記共同祖先而非僅著色兩條線。
summaryEn: Build a directed source, UPS, PDU and load graph with explicit A/B paths. Identify common ancestors instead of simply drawing the two paths in different colors.
scope: 本課採用原創合成工作負載或事件資料，在紙面、試算表與離線模型中實作。來源用於查證具名案例；數值、擾動與驗收門檻是教學假設，不是實機效能或正式環境變更規格。實驗限自己的或明確授權的隔離環境，交付可重算的證據紀錄。
scopeEn: Use original synthetic workloads or event data in paper, spreadsheet, and offline-model investigations. References establish named case context; numerical inputs, perturbations, and limits are teaching assumptions, not measured machine performance or production change specifications. Use owned or explicitly authorized isolated environments and deliver reproducible evidence records.

optionsEn: Broad outage may result from a common upstream component or a control or maintenance action that disables both paths. Physical wiring alone can omit shared operational dependencies. Examine cut sets in both power and control dependencies. Compare predicted affected loads with incident scope, avoiding reliability claims based on product names or dual-line labels alone.

quiz.explanationEn: This step identifies case and source boundary. Equipment with A/B inputs can still depend on one shared upstream UPS. 對照「雙路供電：建立可追溯輸入與所有權」的名義結果，分別建立系統故障與量測／紀錄偏移兩個解釋。指定一項能分辨它們的獨立觀察，再依證據選擇處置。變更雖減少影響，仍有八負載斷線，不能宣稱完整 2N；若要求任一 UPS 失效皆不斷，需更多拓撲修改與測試。
本階段必須重驗：逐負載搜尋剩餘來源路徑，核對十六與八個無路；一條路含重複節點或循環時需拒絕拓撲資料；保存來源、合成輸入及 join/所有權失敗的明確原因；不得悄悄補缺值。
steps.instructionEn:
Broad outage may result from a common upstream component or a control or maintenance action that disables both paths. Physical wiring alone can omit shared operational dependencies. Examine cut sets in both power and control dependencies. Compare predicted affected loads with incident scope, avoiding reliability claims based on product names or dual-line labels alone.
Against the nominal Dual power paths: construct traceable inputs and ownership result, build competing system-fault and sensing/logging-offset explanations. Name an independent observation that separates them and select the disposition from evidence. The change reduces impact but still disconnects eight loads, so it does not establish complete 2N protection. Requiring survival of any UPS loss needs further graph changes and a broader failure matrix.
Reverify this criterion: Search surviving source paths for every load and verify sixteen and eight disconnections. Reject malformed paths with repeated nodes or cycles rather than interpreting them as additional redundancy. Preserve provenance, synthetic inputs and explicit join or ownership failures; do not silently fill missing values.
steps.observation: 證據能區分兩個成因；不足時明列待測量，不把猜測當結案。全數掉電可能是共同祖先失效，也可能是控制或維護操作同時切掉兩路；拓撲須包含共同控制依賴；沿電力與控制關係各自尋找切集；以事故範圍比對受影響負載，不從品牌或雙線標籤推斷可靠度。
steps.observationEn: Evidence separates causes; insufficient evidence remains an open measurement need. Reject malformed paths with repeated nodes or cycles rather than interpreting them as additional redundancy. knowledge.title: 案例與來源邊界
knowledge.text: 設備有 A/B 插頭仍可能共用更上游 UPS；本課從負載回溯兩條路徑，檢查看似 2N 的系統是否有單點。
knowledge.textEn: Equipment with A/B inputs can still depend on one shared upstream UPS. Trace both paths from loads to sources and test whether an apparently redundant topology contains a single cut point.

knowledge.title: 可驗證的工程目標
knowledge.text: 建立 source、UPS、PDU、load 有向圖，每負載列出 A/B 路徑；標記共同祖先而非僅著色兩條線。
knowledge.textEn: Build a directed source, UPS, PDU and load graph with explicit A/B paths. Identify common ancestors instead of simply drawing the two paths in different colors.

knowledge.title: 模型、介面與適用範圍
knowledge.text: 每負載至少一條完整來源路徑存活才可用；移除指定元件後，以圖可達性計算無路徑負載數。
knowledge.textEn: A load remains available only if at least one complete source path survives. Remove the specified component and use reachability to count disconnected loads, rather than counting plugs or cables.

steps.title: 雙路供電：建立可追溯輸入與所有權 · 驗收並留下交接件
steps.titleEn: Dual power paths: construct traceable inputs and ownership · Accept and hand over evidence
steps.objective: 完成「雙路供電：建立可追溯輸入與所有權」的驗收並留下交接件，以本階段判據形成可複查成果。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete accept and hand over evidence for Dual power paths: construct traceable inputs and ownership and produce reviewable evidence against the investigation criterion.
steps.instruction:
交付來源路徑表、共同祖先、X 失效結果與未達條件清單；只移除模型節點。
在交接件中加入「雙路供電：建立可追溯輸入與所有權」的原始資料、計算版本及下列驗收逐項結果：逐負載搜尋剩餘來源路徑，核對十六與八個無路；一條路含重複節點或循環時需拒絕拓撲資料；保存來源、合成輸入及 join/所有權失敗的明確原因；不得悄悄補缺值。
以本課決策條件作有條件結論：建立 source、UPS、PDU、load 有向圖，每負載列出 A/B 路徑；標記共同祖先而非僅著色兩條線。 請接手者依同一輸入重作一項檢查，保留差異與未結案項。
steps.instructionEn:
Deliver source paths, common ancestors, X-failure results and unmet conditions. Fault injection removes nodes only from the model and never sends commands to electrical equipment.
Include raw data, calculation revision, and each acceptance result for Dual power paths: construct traceable inputs and ownership: Search surviving source paths for every load and verify sixteen and eight disconnections. Reject malformed paths with repeated nodes or cycles rather than interpreting them as additional redundancy. Preserve provenance, synthetic inputs and explicit join or ownership failures; do not silently fill missing values.
Use the course decision condition for a conditional conclusion: Build a directed source, UPS, PDU and load graph with explicit A/B paths. Identify common ancestors instead of simply drawing the two paths in different colors. Ask the receiving role to repeat one check with the same inputs and retain discrepancies and open issues.
